Fellow introvert here! There is no "life hack" that I am aware of and frankly it is not easy to get out of your bubble. But even social interactions online like what you did just now, putting yourself out there and having conversations is what I have found to be the most effective route. Not letting fear of what could happen or "things getting awkward" stop you from doing that is the hardest part and the best way I know to get over that is by having conversations. Like what @Stekkerdoos said, doing things you enjoy with people who you enjoy being with (althought it might cost some energy) is a great way to become a socialable introvert!

I reject the idea of a binary introvert v. extrovert.
